ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var json = JSON.parse(result);
var sds = (json.data && json.data.search_data) || [];
var cm = String(baseUrl).match(/[?&]cat=([^&#]+)/);
var cat = cm ? decodeURIComponent(cm[1]) : '';
var out = [];
for (var i = 0; i < sds.length; i++) {
  var books = sds[i].books || [];
  for (var k = 0; k < books.length; k++) {
    var b = books[k];
    if (!b || !b.book_id) continue;
    var names = [];
    var ais = b.author_infos || [];
    for (var a = 0; a < ais.length; a++) { if (ais[a] && ais[a].name) names.push(ais[a].name); }
    var dur = Number(b.audio_duration) || 0;
    var albumName = (b.common_book_info && b.common_book_info.album_title) || '';
    var bookUrl = 'https://m.novelfm.com/music/' + b.book_id + '?bookId=' + b.book_id + '&name=' + encodeURIComponent(b.book_name || '') + '&singer=' + encodeURIComponent(names.join('/')) + '&album=' + encodeURIComponent(albumName) + '&dur=' + dur + '&cover=' + encodeURIComponent(b.thumb_url || '') + '&cat=' + encodeURIComponent(cat);
    out.push({name: String(b.book_name || '').replace(/<\/?em>/g, ''), author: names.join('/') || '未知歌手', cover: b.thumb_url || '', intro: albumName, url: bookUrl, kind: '番茄音乐', lastChapter: '时长：' + dur + '秒'});
  }
}
JSON.stringify({data: out});
</js>
